source_caption_text:
#N3on is an American livestreamer and internet personality known for his high-energy content, viral moments, celebrity collaborations, and IRL streams. He built a large following through gaming and YouTube before becoming especially prominent on Kick, where his streams often feature other creators, rappers, athletes, and internet personalities. N3on has become a recognizable figure in the newer generation of livestreaming, with clips from his broadcasts regularly spreading across social media.

Arman Tsarukyan is a professional MMA fighter who competes in the UFC’s lightweight division at 155 pounds. Born in Georgia and representing Armenia, Tsarukyan is known for his wrestling, grappling, physical strength, and well-rounded MMA game. He made his UFC debut against Islam Makhachev in 2019 and later worked his way into the lightweight division’s top tier with victories over several notable opponents. Tsarukyan has not held a UFC championship, but he has established himself as a leading lightweight contender and was previously scheduled to challenge Makhachev for the UFC lightweight title at UFC 311 before withdrawing due to injury.
